scope: Real Go/SQLite/local filesystem and independent SDK processes with exclusive synthetic directory payloads; no production/NAS or arbitrary cloud verification

external_directory.precall: complete ordinary source tree, exact absent target and parent identity
external_directory.mapping: explicit softlink/local directory and complete bijective source-target file lists
external_directory.physical: real directory nodes, individual real leaf symlinks, exact references to frozen source files
external_directory.cold_recovery: asset SQL failure, application close/reopen, sealed result reused without provider/callback replay
external_directory.callback_file_item: complete provider-supplied FileItem preserved including null directory size

directory_source_actor.binding: source actor instance/key frozen for remaining members
directory_source_actor.call: Source.softlink with frozen complete FileItem, exact logical path, NewName=null and authorized PublicationPath
directory_source_actor.cold_recovery: first actual returned result persisted before staged snapshot, task cancelled, app reopened with a new SDK PID, original stage inode reused
